title: Pin runtime, lockfile and installation prerequisites

commands.invocation: git clone + bun install --frozen-lockfile (isolated checkout, fresh BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR)
commands.result: 1555 packages; bun.lock unchanged by the install

commands.invocation: bun run build (clean checkout, no manual prebuild)
bun install --frozen-lockfile with a deliberately stale lockfile
commands.result: refused: 'lockfile had changes, but lockfile is frozen'; bun.lock NOT rewritten

acceptanceResults.criterion: A frozen-lockfile install succeeds on the declared test matrix.
acceptanceResults.evidence: Isolated git clone with no node_modules and no dist, fresh BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR: 1555 packages installed, exit 0, bun.lock byte-identical afterwards. The declared matrix is one configuration - the digest-pinned image - and provenance/runtime-contract.json states that explicitly rather than implying host support.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Missing runtimes or native dependencies are reported before attempting a render.
acceptanceResults.evidence: bun run doctor executes each dependency and compares versions. 22 tests cover missing file, directory instead of binary, non-executable, wrong version, hanging probe, non-zero and timed-out probes, and a concealed explicit override.

acceptanceResults.criterion: No claim that any Node >=18 installation runs the combined product.
acceptanceResults.evidence: diagram-engine raised from >=18 to >=22; root declares node >=22 and bun >=1.3.13. The binding statement for the combined product is provenance/runtime-contract.json, which also distinguishes the one supported configuration from untested-but-not-unsupported ones.

findings.summary: The runtime doctor had two false-positive paths.
findings.detail: The headless-shell check tested only for file existence, so a wrong-version or non-executable file passed; because it selected the first existing candidate, an invalid explicit PRODUCER_HEADLESS_SHELL_PATH was concealed by validating the fallback instead. checkExecutable substituted the pathname when the version probe failed, so 'found on PATH' reported as ok. No probe had a timeout.
findings.consequence: Discovery and execution are now separate fields, probes are bounded at 10s with distinct failure reasons, the headless shell is executed and version-compared, and an explicit override is never replaced by a fallback. Found in external source review, not by our own tests - the tests were written after, to cover exactly these paths.

findings.summary: The base image was pinned only by a moving tag.
findings.detail: node:22-bookworm-slim can resolve to different builds over time, so it does not identify a reproducible environment.
findings.consequence: Pinned by digest. provenance/runtime-contract.json records the exact observed toolchain and notes that pinning the base does not freeze later apt/npm downloads.

findings.summary: The clean-checkout build initially failed because the fixes were uncommitted.
findings.detail: The first clean-checkout run reported 'Script not found: doctor' and a filter miss, because a clone sees committed state only.
findings.consequence: Confirms the clean-checkout test is meaningful rather than reading the working tree. Re-run after committing: exit 0.

notPerformed: Host (non-container) execution on Windows, macOS or bare Linux is untested. Recorded as untested-not-unsupported in the runtime contract rather than claimed.
arm64 is untested; the digest and headless-shell path are linux/amd64.
Full producer unit and integration lanes were not executed here; that remains AFM-012.
